sanskrit_verse: पूर्वोत्तरे संनिविष्टे विचारे संप्रवर्तिते । प्रशमं ये मिथो यान्ति दाप्यस्ते द्विगुणं दमम् ॥
transliteration: pūrvottare saṃniviṣṭe vicāre saṃpravartite | praśamaṃ ye mitho yānti dāpyas te dviguṇaṃ damam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When two parties are seated for mutual inquiry and resolution, and they attain tranquility through mutual consent, both shall incur a doubled obligation to uphold harmony.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious agreement, not coercion
Causation is traced to disruption of mutual equilibrium
Capacity-based responsibility is amplified by voluntary alignment
Restoration logic prioritizes consensual settlement over adversarial outcome
Consciousness alignment is cultivated through reciprocal stillness
executable_legal_axioms: IF parties engage in mutual inquiry AND reach reciprocal calm THEN enforce doubled duty of harmonious conduct
IF dispute resolution initiates voluntary dialogue THEN punitive measures are nullified automatically
IF both parties demonstrate capacity for self-regulation THEN external enforcement is suspended
IF mutual settlement occurs THEN record as completion-event in consciousness-led registry
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, when litigants arrive at mutual resolution during judicial proceedings, the court shall recognize their consensual stillness as evidence of restored capacity. The doubling of dharmic duty replaces any punitive imposition, aligning judgment with the higher truth of shared sovereignty.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that peace between disputants is causally prior to judicial intervention. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that mutual calm manifests only when consciousness awakens in both. Thus, proportional responsibility lies in sustaining that awakened state, not inflicting consequence. This upholds the non-punitive reality rule wherein justice serves integration alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate joint completion process to reaffirm shared values
Assign collaborative dharma-service to strengthen collective integrity
Activate witness council to sustain transparency of renewed commitment
Establish periodic review cycles until alignment stabilizes organically
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is hereby restored through the doubling of harmony-bound duty. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the sole adjudicator.
